spec.description: SIPI IIIF media server, driven by SIPI's OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics (service_name=sipi). Latency, throughput, caching, decode-memory, two-lane admission saturation, errors, plus the dsp-api /admin/files permission route SIPI calls on every request. The legacy Prometheus scrape (service DSP_iiif_iiif) is intentionally excluded.

spec.title: Environment
spec.description: Ansible host (OTLP resource attribute deployment.environment.name) the dashboard is reading: the primary VRE box vre-$environment-01. SIPI also runs on LS/RDU hosts; all panels here are scoped to this host only.

spec.title: SIPI Version
spec.description: service.version from the OTLP resource (attached to all spans and metrics), most recently reported by the primary VRE host.

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: HTTP requests per second served by SIPI (OTLP http.server.request.duration count), all routes, primary VRE host.

spec.title: P95 Latency
spec.description: 95th-percentile HTTP request latency across all SIPI routes (OTLP http.server.request.duration), primary VRE host.

spec.title: Cache Hit Ratio
spec.description: Share of serves answered from the file-based image cache: hits / (hits + misses). A falling ratio means more full decodes, i.e. higher CPU and latency.

spec.title: 5xx Rate
spec.description: Server-error responses per second (HTTP 5xx), all SIPI routes, primary VRE host.

spec.title: Latency Percentiles (p50/p95/p99)
spec.description: p50/p95/p99 HTTP request latency across all SIPI routes (OTLP http.server.request.duration histogram), primary VRE host.

spec.title: Auth route request rate by status (/admin/files)
spec.description: dsp-api permission check SIPI calls on every IIIF request (tapir_request_duration_seconds, scoped by instance to the primary VRE host). 4xx = auth denials, 5xx = errors.

spec.title: Auth route avg latency (/admin/files)
spec.description: Average latency of the dsp-api permission check (rate of sum / rate of count; the tapir metric has no histogram buckets, so no percentiles). Adds directly to every IIIF request.

spec.title: Cache Usage vs Limit
spec.description: Bytes in the file-based image cache vs the configured size limit (sipi.cache.size_bytes / size_limit_bytes). LRU eviction starts when a limit is reached; an unlimited cache (-1) hides the limit series.

spec.title: Cache Files vs Limit
spec.description: Files in the image cache vs the configured file-count limit. Dual-limit LRU: eviction triggers on size or file count, whichever is hit first.

spec.title: Cache Evictions & Skips (rate)
spec.description: Cache maintenance per second: entries evicted by the LRU, and writes skipped because the file was too large to cache.

spec.title: Preflight Cache Hit Ratio
spec.description: Share of preflight authorization decisions served from the in-shell access cache (a hit skips the Lua preflight hook entirely).

spec.title: Decode Memory: Full-lane Used vs Budget
spec.description: Full-lane accounted decode bytes (sipi_decode_memory_used_bytes) against the full-lane budget (sipi_decode_memory_budget_bytes = envelope x (1 - tiles_memory_ratio), ~75%). Tiles bypass the budget. Used approaching Budget is where 503s begin in advanced mode.

spec.title: Decode Memory Admission (rate)
spec.description: Decode-memory budget decisions (advanced mode): acquired = admitted; rejected = 503, budget currently exhausted; too large = 413, a single request's estimate alone exceeds the full-lane budget; near_limit = usage crossed 80% of budget. Cumulative process-lifetime counters; rate() is correct.

spec.title: Admission Permits (in use vs total)
spec.description: Global admission permits held vs total (SIPI_NTHREADS). In use = total means every worker is busy and further requests queue or shed.

spec.title: Admission Waiting (per partition)
spec.description: Requests parked waiting for a permit, per partition. Tiles are exempt from the full-partition queue-depth shed, so a full burst never fills the queue against tiles.

spec.title: Admission Load-Shed (per partition, rate)
spec.description: Requests shed per partition (immediate queue-full shed + queue-timeout shed, combined into one counter per partition). The tile partition should stay flat under a full-lane burst. Cumulative counters; rate() is correct.

spec.title: Errors (rate)
spec.description: Error-class rates. decode too large = 413 (single request exceeds the full-lane budget); budget rejected = 503 (budget currently exhausted); alloc failures / client disconnected as before.

spec.title: SIPI Container CPU Usage
spec.description: cAdvisor CPU usage of the SIPI container (service DSP_iiif_iiif) on the primary VRE host, in cores.

spec.title: SIPI Container Memory Usage
spec.description: cAdvisor container metrics for the SIPI container (service DSP_iiif_iiif) on the primary VRE host. 'working set' is the real, non-reclaimable memory the cgroup OOM killer acts on; 'usage (incl. page cache)' additionally counts reclaimable page cache from reading image files, so it saturates at the limit under load without indicating a problem. 'limit' is the container memory limit - working set approaching it risks an OOM kill. On images before SIPI 6.2.3 the working set ratchets up to a concurrency x peak-decode watermark and plateaus (glibc malloc arenas retain freed decode buffers); that is expected, not a leak. 'decode envelope' overlays SIPI's decode-memory envelope (sipi_admission_memory_limit_bytes, 0=auto-detected cgroup limit) for reference.

spec.title: Decode Memory Estimate (p50/p95/p99)
spec.description: Estimated peak decode memory per request, from the sipi_decode_memory_estimate_bytes histogram. The engine classifies tile vs full from this estimate; p99 tracks the crawler large-download cost that drove the OOM incident.

spec.title: Allocator: RSS In Use vs Retained
spec.description: mimalloc in-use bytes vs retained. As of SIPI v5 (fix 9d7f69ff) sipi_malloc_retained_bytes is remapped to true RSS held but not in use (current_rss - in_use), not mimalloc committed. Retained is the glibc-style arena retention watched for the RSS ratchet.

spec.title: Allocator: Process RSS & mmap-served
spec.description: As of SIPI v5 (fix 9d7f69ff) sipi_malloc_arena_bytes is remapped to the process RSS (mi_process_info current_rss), a true OOM/RSS proxy; mmap-served is the mmap share outside the regular heap. Sanity-check RSS against container_memory_working_set_bytes in Resources.

spec.title: Full-lane Occupancy vs Cap
spec.description: Full-download decodes in flight (sipi_admission_full_in_use) against the hard thread cap (sipi_admission_full_max_threads = nthreads - tile_min). In use pinned at the cap means fulls are being capped so tiles keep their floor.

spec.title: Classifier Disagreement (rate)
spec.description: Rate of requests where the shell tile/full classifier disagreed with the engine's estimate-based classification (sipi_admission_classifier_disagreement_total). Non-zero is expected and tolerated; a sustained rise means the shell pixel-proxy threshold has drifted from the engine's byte threshold. Cumulative counter; rate() is correct.

spec.title: Admission Mode
spec.description: Resolved admission mode: basic = enforce only the CPU/thread cap (advanced tier observe-only); advanced = also enforce the memory budget + two-lane shedding (503/413). Every environment ships advanced.

spec.title: Memory Envelope
spec.description: Resolved decode-memory envelope (sipi_admission_memory_limit_bytes). 0-config auto-detects the container cgroup limit; the full-lane budget is 75% of this.

spec.title: Tiles Memory Ratio
spec.description: Fraction of the envelope reserved for the tile partition (1 - full-lane share). Default 0.25.

spec.title: Tiles Thread Ratio
spec.description: Fraction of nthreads guaranteed to the tile partition as a floor (tile_min = round(nthreads x ratio)). Default 0.5.

spec.title: Tile Min Threads
spec.description: Guaranteed tile thread floor (tile_min). Tiles burst above this into idle capacity up to nthreads.

spec.title: Full Max Threads
spec.description: Hard cap on concurrent full-download decodes (full_max = nthreads - tile_min).

spec.title: Large Decode Threshold
spec.description: Estimated-peak byte threshold at or above which a request is classified full (sipi_admission_large_decode_threshold_bytes). Single-sourced in the shell config, passed to the engine over the seam. Default 32 MiB.

spec.title: SIPI IIIF Media Server
